pages.text: Dwarfs are artisans by vocation. Smiths, armorers, and tinkerers are traditional professions.$(br2)Never touch a dwarf's beard without permission. This is equivalent to a grave insult.
Dwarf gender is a private matter. Don't ask. Don't guess. Don't comment. All dwarfs wear beards and leather aprons — this is not a $(italic)clue$().$(br2)Respect the craft above all.
